title: IBM Bob 1.0.4 through 2.0.1 could allow a remote attacker to inject arbitrary code on the system, due… (CVE-2026-9764)
description: IBM Bob versions 1.0.4 through 2.0.1 contain a vulnerability that allows remote attackers to inject arbitrary code due to improper control of user-supplied input. This flaw can lead to full compromise of confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the affected system.
